**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir um relatório curto e bem estruturado a partir de um conto/cena sobre um laboratório que perdeu amostras.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Story: The Freezer Failure
paras: At 3 a.m., the alarm sounded. **Hardly had** Dr. Reis reached the lab **when** she saw the warning light. The freezer had failed, and decades of samples were at risk. **Were** the temperature **to rise** further, everything would be lost.
**It was** her quick action **that** saved most of the collection. At dawn she wrote the incident report: cause, impact, **and it is recommended that** backup generators be installed.

items.q: Dr. Reis saved most of the samples.
She wrote a report with recommendations.

blocks.body: Em relatórios, use **passiva**, **dados precisos** e **tempo verbal coerente** (passado para fatos, presente para conclusões).

items.s: This report ___ the failure of Freezer 4. (describe)
The failure was ___ by a power cut. (cause, part.)
It is recommended that backup generators ___ installed. (be)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Raise the alarm.** — Dar o alarme.
**Save the day.** — Salvar a situação.
**Better safe than sorry.** — Melhor prevenir que remediar.
**In the nick of time.** — Na hora H.
**Damage control.** — Controle de danos.
**A close call.** — Por pouco.
**Lessons learned.** — Lições aprendidas.
**Learn from experience.** — Aprender com a experiência.
**What happened at 3 a.m.?** — O que aconteceu às 3h?
**The freezer failed and the alarm sounded.** — O congelador falhou e o alarme tocou.
**What saved the samples?** — O que salvou as amostras?

lines: The freezer failed and the alarm sounded.
O congelador falhou e o alarme tocou.

Foi a ação rápida da Dra. Reis que salvou a maioria.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: It is recommended that generators be installed.

blocks.task: Write an incident report (8 sentences) with Introduction, Findings, Conclusions and Recommendations.
blocks.model: Introduction: This report describes the failure of Freezer 4 on 12 June. Findings: The alarm sounded at 3 a.m. The temperature rose to −20°C within an hour. Staff transferred 90% of the samples to a backup unit. Conclusions: The failure was caused by a power cut. It was quick action that limited the damage. Recommendations: It is recommended that backup generators be installed and that alarms be tested monthly.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
